# railway_project (Data Source)

Reads a Railway project by its exact identifier.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "railway_project" "charming" {
  id = "0bb01547-570d-4109-a5e8-138691f6a2d1"
}

output "project_name" {
  value = data.railway_project.charming.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifier of the project.

### Read-Only

- `name` (String) Name of the project.
- `workspace_id` (String) Identifier of the workspace containing the project, when available.
